changelog.notes: Released, after an independent audit of every card against its source.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 454 cards against the Scrum, Nexus, Evidence-Based Management and Kanban Guides, and checked every scenario's explanation letters against its choices
checks.result: 1 wrong card, 5 ambiguous, 7 unsupported and 4 unclear were fixed; 63 cards that only repeated the Scrum Guide and Product Owner decks were removed; 106 fixes in all.
